insights.concise_text: The proposed cross-lingual pre-training based transfer approach addresses the domain shift problem that causes zero-shot translation failure in transfer learning.

triple.subject: cross-lingual pre-training based transfer approach
triple.object: the domain shift problem causing zero-shot translation failure in transfer learning

insights.concise_text: BRLM is designed to obtain a universal encoder that enables the pivot→target parent model to directly translate source sentences into target sentences.

triple.subject: BRLM
triple.object: direct source→target translation by the pivot→target parent model through a universal encoder

insights.concise_text: The zero-shot scenario with source↔pivot and pivot↔target parallel data but no source↔target parallel data is evaluated on Europarl and MultiUN using BLEU.

triple.subject: the zero-shot scenario with source↔pivot and pivot↔target parallel data but no source↔target parallel data
triple.object: Europarl and MultiUN using BLEU

insights.concise_text: MLM+BRLM-SA improves by 0.9-4.8 BLEU points over pivoting, the strongest baseline on Europarl.

triple.subject: MLM+BRLM-SA
triple.object: pivoting by 0.9-4.8 BLEU points on Europarl

insights.concise_text: MLM+BRLM-SA has the most stable and similar cross-lingual sentence-pair representations on all layers while achieving the best zero-shot translation performance.

triple.subject: MLM+BRLM-SA
triple.object: better cross-lingual representations to benefit transfer learning

insights.concise_text: MLM+BRLM-SA gains better word-level representation alignment between source and pivot languages, which better relieves the burden of the domain shift problem.

triple.subject: MLM+BRLM-SA
triple.object: the burden of the domain shift problem through better word-level representation alignment

insights.concise_text: BRLM-SA avoids external wrong alignment information, and MLM+BRLM-SA performs better than MLM+BRLM-HA, indicating soft alignment is helpful.

triple.subject: BRLM-SA
triple.object: BRLM-HA by avoiding external wrong alignment information

insights.concise_text: Freezing several layers of the pre-trained universal encoder avoids the degeneracy issue, and freezing the first four layers of the transformer shows the best performance.

triple.subject: freezing the first four layers of the transformer
triple.object: the strategy of freezing several layers to avoid the degeneracy issue

insights.concise_text: The pretraining phase builds a cross-lingual encoder shared by source and pivot languages, enabling the transfer phase to train pivot→target NMT and transfer it to source→target translation.

triple.subject: the pretraining phase
triple.object: the transfer phase to train pivot→target NMT and transfer it to source→target translation

insights.concise_text: MLM+BRLM-SA with back translation outperforms pivoting_m by 2.4 BLEU points averagely and MNMT BIBREF22 by 4.6 BLEU points averagely on MultiUN.

triple.subject: MLM+BRLM-SA with back translation
triple.object: pivoting_m by 2.4 BLEU points averagely and MNMT BIBREF22 by 4.6 BLEU points averagely
